description: This file serves as a source module implementing plugin SDK resolution and proxy management for a Node.js project. It provides functions for loading plugin SDK components, resolving paths, and handling module proxies to support dynamic module resolution.

methods.name: emptyPluginConfigSchema
methods.description: Creates and returns a schema object for plugin configuration, with validation logic for ensuring the config object is empty.

methods.name: resolveCommandAuthorizedFromAuthorizers
methods.description: Determines whether a command is authorized based on provided authorizer configurations.

methods.name: resolveControlCommandGate
methods.description: Determines if control commands should be permitted or blocked based on authorization logic.

methods.name: onDiagnosticEvent
methods.description: Registers a listener for diagnostic events via the diagnostic events module.

methods.name: getPackageRoot
methods.description: Returns the root directory of the package based on the current module's filename.

methods.name: findDistChunkByPrefix
methods.description: Searches the distribution directory for a chunk file matching a specific prefix.

methods.name: listPluginSdkExportedSubpaths
methods.description: Retrieves the list of subpaths exported by plugin SDK as specified in package.json.

methods.name: buildPluginSdkAliasMap
methods.description: Constructs an alias map for JITI loader based on plugin SDK subpaths.

methods.name: getJiti
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a JITI loader instance for dynamic module import with aliasing.

methods.name: loadMonolithicSdk
methods.description: Loads the monolithic plugin SDK, preferring distribution build or source depending on configuration.

methods.name: loadDiagnosticEventsModule
methods.description: Loads the diagnostic events module, preferring distribution build but falling back to source.

methods.name: normalizeDiagnosticEventsModule
methods.description: Ensures the loaded diagnostic events module has the expected interface.

methods.name: tryLoadMonolithicSdk
methods.description: Attempts to load the monolithic SDK, returning null if unsuccessful.

methods.name: getExportValue
methods.description: Retrieves a property from the SDK proxy or monolithic SDK, supporting dynamic resolution.

methods.name: getExportDescriptor
methods.description: Retrieves property descriptor for a given property, supporting proxy behavior.

methods.name: getMonolithicSdk
methods.description: Returns the currently loaded monolithic SDK if available.
